newsitem.title: USA: Forasol-Foramer stake cut by group.
newsitem.headline: Forasol-Foramer stake cut by group.

text.p: A group led by Appaloosa Management L.P. said Thursdy it cut its stake in Forasol-Foramer N.V to 450,000 common shares or 2.70 percent from 5.04 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net of 401,800 common sold between Sept 12 and Oct 30 at prices ranging from $11.625 to $17.08 per share.
Appaloosa is a Short-Hills, New Jersey-based investment partnership.

Forasol, a unit of Ackermans & Van Haaren, a Belgian holding company, is due to merge with Pride Petroleum Services Inc, a Houston-based provider of contract drilling and plugging and abandonment services.
The merger agreement is still subject to due diligence and approval of the boards and authorities.
